0.0.en: Morning light fills my small old shop, where every piece of [[stuff:stuff]] and second-hand [[merchandise:merchandise]] holds a past life.
0.0.zh: 晨光洒满我的旧小店，这里每件旧物、每件二手商品都藏着一段过去。

0.1.en: A girl walks in with a worn travel [[souvenir:souvenir]] and a [[clay:clay]] [[artifact:artifact]] her kind grandmother left her.
0.1.zh: 一个女孩走进店里，带来一件磨损的旅行纪念品，还有她慈祥奶奶留下的一件陶土手工艺品。

0.2.en: I check the [[raw:raw]] wood and the [[crude:crude]] joints [[first:first]], then plan each [[gentle:gentle]] repair [[step:step]].
0.2.zh: 我先检查生木料和粗糙的接缝，再为每一步轻柔的修补做好计划。

0.3.en: Warm coats are a winter [[necessity:necessity]], so I decide to repair her torn [[festival:festival]] [[outfit:outfit]] today.
0.3.zh: 保暖外套是冬天的必需品，所以我决定今天补好她那件撕破的节日套装。

0.4.en: I open my repair [[kit:kit]] and lift each little chrome [[utensil:utensil]] with slow care.
0.4.zh: 我打开修补工具箱，小心地拿起每一件小小的镀铬用具。

0.5.en: People call such things roadside [[rubbish:rubbish]], yet I [[reuse:reuse]] them and turn them into gifts full of warmth.
0.5.zh: 人们管这些东西叫路边垃圾，可我把它们重新利用，做成满是暖意的礼物。

1.0.en: This bent board once lay in a [[junk:junk]] pile beside the old city [[landfill:landfill]].
1.0.zh: 这块弯木板原先躺在旧城填埋场边的一堆废旧杂物里。

1.1.en: Street [[sewerage:sewerage]] work had left it under a coat of [[dust:dust]], so I washed it with a [[mild:mild]] [[detergent:detergent]].
1.1.zh: 街道排污施工让它蒙上了一层灰，于是我用了温和的洗涤剂把它洗净。

1.2.en: A caregiver drops by with hand [[lotion:lotion]] and a low wide [[tub:tub]] for soaking dirty cloth.
1.2.zh: 护理员顺路送来护手乳液和一只泡脏布用的矮宽盆。

1.3.en: I [[pull:pull]] out the little [[plug:plug]] and turn on the old [[tap:tap]] to rinse the [[frame:frame]] clean.
1.3.zh: 我拔掉小塞子，拧开旧水龙头，把框架冲洗干净。

1.4.en: A short zinc [[pipe:pipe]] and a soft [[hollow:hollow]] [[tube:tube]] hold the legs firmly together.
1.4.zh: 一截短锌管和一根软空心管把桌腿牢牢固定在一起。

1.5.en: Before starting work, I clean the floor with a wet [[mop:mop]] and an old [[straw:straw]] [[broom:broom]].
1.5.zh: 动工之前，我先用湿拖把和旧草扫帚把地面打扫干净。

2.0.en: An old man then brings in a thin torn [[mattress:mattress]] and a dusty rolled-up [[carpet:carpet]].
2.0.zh: 接着一位老人带来一张又薄又破的床垫和一卷落灰的地毯。

2.1.en: His small flowered [[rug:rug]] and door [[mat:mat]] both need fresh edges and a brighter color.
2.1.zh: 他的碎花小地毯和门口垫子都需要包上新边、添点亮色。

2.2.en: I fill each [[flat:flat]] seat [[cushion:cushion]] with a soft [[feather:feather]] [[pad:pad]] so it feels comfortable again.
2.2.zh: 我在每个瘪掉的坐垫里塞进柔软的羽毛垫芯，让它重新舒服起来。

2.3.en: His baby's blue [[blanket:blanket]] and the cherished wedding [[quilt:quilt]] both smell of long years in the sun.
2.3.zh: 宝宝的蓝毛毯和那床珍爱的婚被，都带着多年日晒的味道。

2.4.en: I wash the yellowed [[pillow:pillow]] and scrub its marks away with a soft [[sponge:sponge]].
2.4.zh: 我把发黄的枕头洗干净，用软海绵擦去上面的污渍。

2.5.en: Then I dry it with a thick white [[towel:towel]] and clip its label back on with one small [[staple:staple]].
2.5.zh: 再用厚白毛巾把它擦干，用一枚小订书钉把标签夹回去。

3.0.en: I pull out each old [[nail:nail]] and cut away the loose edges with a sharp [[razor:razor]].
3.0.zh: 我拔出每颗旧钉子，再用锋利的剃刀切掉翘起的毛边。

3.1.en: Each [[rough:rough]] corner is [[shave:shaved]] [[smooth:smooth]], and the faulty safety [[fuse:fuse]] is replaced with a new one.
3.1.zh: 粗糙的边角被刮得平平的，坏掉的保险丝也换上了新的。

3.2.en: A black power [[cable:cable]] and a long white [[cord:cord]] hang quietly behind the desk.
3.2.zh: 一条黑色电源电缆和一条白色长电线安静地垂在书桌后面。

3.3.en: I twirl each loose wire [[strand:strand]] into place, then light a small honey-scented [[candle:candle]].
3.3.zh: 我把每股松散的线丝绕好归位，再点上一支蜂蜜香味的小蜡烛。

3.4.en: Warm [[wax:wax]] drips softly while I read repair tips from an old [[paperback:paperback]].
3.4.zh: 温热的蜡一滴滴落下，我边等边读旧平装书里的修补窍门。

3.5.en: A picture [[pamphlet:pamphlet]] shows old crafts, and I keep the small parts wrapped in soft [[tissue:tissue]].
3.5.zh: 一本图画小册子介绍着老手艺，我把小零件包进软纸巾里收好。

4.0.en: I [[xerox:xerox]] the old invoice, then put the short [[memorandum:memorandum]] up on the wall above my desk.
4.0.zh: 我把旧发票复印一份，再把那张简短的备忘录贴到书桌上方的墙上。

4.1.en: My drawer of old [[stationery:stationery]] looks messy, yet the strong [[glue:glue]] still works well.
4.1.zh: 旧文具抽屉看着乱，可那管强力胶水依然好用。

4.2.en: Blue [[ink:ink]] marks my notebook while a thick [[rubber:rubber]] [[band:band]] holds the pages together.
4.2.zh: 蓝墨水在笔记本上留下痕迹，一圈粗橡皮筋把书页箍在一起。

4.3.en: With a pair of large silver [[scissors:scissors]], I [[shear:shear]] the loose threads from the thick cloth along the white line.
4.3.zh: 我拿一把大银剪刀沿着白线剪开厚布，把松散的线头也剪掉。

4.4.en: The [[round:round]] chair [[rim:rim]] is loose, but every carved [[element:element]] stays truly beautiful.
4.4.zh: 椅子的圆边松了，可每一处雕花依然好看。

4.5.en: Cost is only one small [[factor:factor]], so I repair just the worst-damaged [[section:section]].
4.5.zh: 价钱只是一个小因素，所以我只修补损坏最重的那部分。

5.0.en: I shine his old school [[badge:badge]] and tighten each tiny silver [[bolt:bolt]].
5.0.zh: 我把他的旧校徽擦亮，再拧紧每颗小银螺栓。

5.1.en: A [[round:round]] door [[knob:knob]] and a curved drawer [[handle:handle]] also need a [[gentle:gentle]] fixing today.
5.1.zh: 圆门把和弯抽屉柄今天也要轻轻修一修。

5.2.en: The battered window [[shutter:shutter]] shakes in the wind, while the long flowered [[curtain:curtain]] hangs still.
5.2.zh: 破旧的百叶窗在风里直晃，长长的碎花窗帘却静静垂着。

5.3.en: I change the cracked window [[pane:pane]], for its cloudy [[opacity:opacity]] blocks the warm light.
5.3.zh: 我换掉那块裂了的窗玻璃，因为它雾蒙蒙不透亮，挡住了暖光。

5.4.en: Buttons sleep in a glass [[jar:jar]], and old hooks rest inside a small [[barrel:barrel]].
5.4.zh: 纽扣睡在玻璃罐里，旧挂钩躺在小木桶中。

5.5.en: I carry water in a red [[bucket:bucket]] and rinse my brushes in a little enamel [[pail:pail]].
5.5.zh: 我用红水桶提水，再在小搪瓷桶里涮洗刷子。

6.0.en: The shop [[phone:phone]] rings twice, and then the little door [[bell:bell]] sings merrily.
6.0.zh: 店里的电话响了两声，接着小门铃欢快地唱起来。

6.1.en: My [[portable:portable]] lamp is handy, but the strong [[spotlight:spotlight]] shows up every defect.
6.1.zh: 便携小灯很顺手，可强射灯一照，每处瑕疵都藏不住。

6.2.en: The old [[paper:paper]] [[lantern:lantern]] glows softly again after I change its little warm [[bulb:bulb]].
6.2.zh: 换上小暖灯泡，旧纸灯笼又柔柔地亮了起来。

6.3.en: My pocket [[flashlight:flashlight]] helps me peer behind the humming old [[refrigerator:refrigerator]].
6.3.zh: 我打着口袋手电，照看那台嗡嗡作响的旧冰箱后面。

6.4.en: The small [[fridge:fridge]] keeps humming while I clean up the [[dust:dust]] with the loud [[vacuum:vacuum]].
6.4.zh: 小冰箱一直嗡嗡响，我用吵人的吸尘器把灰尘清理干净。

6.5.en: A worn delivery [[hurdle:hurdle]] and a fallen garden [[fence:fence]] wait for repair behind the shop.
6.5.zh: 店后还有用旧的送货跨架和倒了的花园栅栏等着修。

7.0.en: I oil the loose bike [[pedal:pedal]] and straighten the long leaning wall [[shelf:shelf]].
7.0.zh: 我给松动的自行车脚踏上油，把歪斜的长墙架扶正。

7.1.en: Then I [[climb:climb]] my short red [[ladder:ladder]] to reach the tall three-legged [[painting:painting]] [[stool:stool]] in the corner.
7.1.zh: 然后我爬上矮矮的红梯子，去够角落里那张高高的三脚刷漆凳。

7.2.en: By the door, a torn black [[umbrella:umbrella]] and a yellowed child's [[raincoat:raincoat]] keep [[drip:dripping]].
7.2.zh: 门边那把破黑伞和小孩发黄的雨衣还在滴滴答答地淌水。

7.3.en: I [[dredge:dredge]] the thick mud from the bottom of the old well and [[pour:pour]] it into a rusty enamel [[can:can]].
7.3.zh: 我把旧井底的厚泥清捞出来，倒进一只生锈的搪瓷罐里。

7.4.en: The old [[mill:mill]] has closed down, so I warm the joints at a neighbor's small [[forge:forge]].
7.4.zh: 老磨坊已经关门，我只好去邻居的小锻炉那里把接头烧热。

7.5.en: This light [[alloy:alloy]] [[frame:frame]] feels softer than pure [[metal:metal]].
7.5.zh: 这个轻巧的合金框架摸起来比纯金属软一些。

8.0.en: An old [[flat:flat]] [[iron:iron]] stands beside a shining candlestick of yellow [[brass:brass]].
8.0.zh: 一只旧扁熨斗立在闪亮的黄铜烛台旁。

8.1.en: A small green [[bronze:bronze]] [[horse:horse]] sits next to a bag of grey [[cement:cement]].
8.1.zh: 一匹绿锈小铜马挨着一袋灰水泥摆放。

8.2.en: White powdered [[lime:lime]] and [[smooth:smooth]] wall [[plaster:plaster]] repair the cracked corner nicely.
8.2.zh: 白石灰粉和平滑的墙面灰浆把裂开的墙角补得整整齐齐。

8.3.en: A cracked brown [[leather:leather]] bag and a clear [[plastic:plastic]] cover are waiting for their turn.
8.3.zh: 裂了口的棕色皮包和透明塑料罩正等着轮流打理。

8.4.en: Each plant [[fibre:fibre]] feels [[rough:rough]], while the soft blue [[fabric:fabric]] feels [[smooth:smooth]].
8.4.zh: 每根植物纤维摸着粗，柔软的蓝布料摸着滑。

8.5.en: Grandma loves to [[knit:knit]] warm caps, and I [[weave:weave]] the torn seat anew.
8.5.zh: 奶奶爱织暖帽，我把破了的椅面重新编好。

9.0.en: A thick painted [[canvas:canvas]] and white table [[linen:linen]] cover the worktop.
9.0.zh: 厚厚的画布和白色亚麻桌布铺在工作台上。

9.1.en: Soft white [[cotton:cotton]] shirts and a strong blue [[nylon:nylon]] bag hang outdoors to dry.
9.1.zh: 软白的棉衬衫和结实的蓝尼龙包挂在外头晾晒。

9.2.en: Freshly cut [[lumber:lumber]] smells sweet, and every [[wooden:wooden]] leg shines after oiling.
9.2.zh: 新锯的木料气味清甜，每条木腿上完油都发亮。

9.3.en: A date [[pit:pit]] lies near the heater, where wood is our [[steady:steady]] winter [[fuel:fuel]].
9.3.zh: 一颗枣核躺在暖气边，在这里木头是我们过冬的稳定燃料。

9.4.en: I [[lubricate:lubricate]] each stiff hinge, then hang up a clear shining [[crystal:crystal]] pendant.
9.4.zh: 我给每个发紧的铰链上润滑油，再挂起一颗透亮的水晶吊坠。

9.5.en: No [[inferior:inferior]] parts stay in this shop, and every [[counterfeit:counterfeit]] coin goes back to the man who brought it.
9.5.zh: 劣质零件在我店里一概不留，假币也退还给拿来的人。

10.0.en: A [[fake:fake]] pearl breaks fast, for its thin painted shell is quite [[fragile:fragile]].
10.0.zh: 假珍珠碎得快，它那层薄薄的漆壳实在太脆弱。

10.1.en: A [[miniature:miniature]] model chair is the only gift still [[available:available]] today.
10.1.zh: 一把微缩的模型小椅，是今天唯一还有货的礼物。

10.2.en: Strong seams make each repair [[durable:durable]], and that slowly wins me [[popularity:popularity]] among the neighbors.
10.2.zh: 结实的缝线让每处修补都耐用，这也慢慢让我在邻居中间有了好口碑。

10.3.en: Short capes are in [[vogue:vogue]], but warm snugness will always [[prevail:prevail]] here.
10.3.zh: 短斗篷正时髦，可在我们这儿，暖和舒服永远占上风。

10.4.en: A young [[idol:idol]] loves [[plain:plain]] dress, not the flashy [[luxury:luxury]] of the shops.
10.4.zh: 一位年轻偶像偏爱朴素的穿着，不喜欢店里那种张扬的奢华。

10.5.en: No [[extravagant:extravagant]] spending is needed when old family [[jewellery:jewellery]] shines anew.
10.5.zh: 旧传家首饰重新发亮时，根本不用乱花一分钱。

11.0.en: Each tiny bright [[jewel:jewel]] and polished blue [[gem:gem]] glows in the little dish on my table.
11.0.zh: 每颗细小明亮的珠宝、每颗磨亮的蓝色宝石，都在我桌上小盘里发着光。

11.1.en: A pale green [[jade:jade]] ring will [[adorn:adorn]] the cover of the old music box.
11.1.zh: 一枚淡绿玉戒指将装点旧音乐盒的盖子。

11.2.en: Every little gold [[ornament:ornament]] will [[embellish:embellish]] the [[plain:plain]] [[festival:festival]] dress.
11.2.zh: 每枚小金饰都会把那件素色的节日裙子装点得更美。

11.3.en: I [[embroider:embroider]] red flowers while my sister practises [[gentle:gentle]] wedding [[hairdressing:hairdressing]] on a young bride.
11.3.zh: 我绣着红花，妹妹则在一位年轻新娘头上练习温柔的美发手艺。

11.4.en: [[natural:Natural]] green [[pigment:pigment]] and a safe brown [[dye:dye]] give the pale cloth its color.
11.4.zh: 天然绿颜料和安全的棕色染料给浅色布料上了色。

11.5.en: For the [[spring:spring]] [[masquerade:masquerade]] dance, she wears a thin shining [[veil:veil]].
11.5.zh: 春季假面舞会上，她戴着一条轻薄的闪光面纱。

paraZh.0: 清晨小店开门，女孩送来旧物，我定下修补计划。
paraZh.1: 旧木板洗净组装成架，动手前先把店里打扫干净。
paraZh.2: 老人送来床垫地毯枕被，我逐件清洗修补如新。
paraZh.3: 拔钉刮角换保险丝，点蜡读书整理小零件。
paraZh.4: 复印单据整理文具，剪布修椅只补最坏处。
paraZh.5: 擦徽修把换窗玻璃，纽扣挂钩归位备好水。
paraZh.6: 电话门铃响起，灯泡冰箱吸尘器逐一检查。
paraZh.7: 上油扶架够高凳，清井泥烧热接头查合金。
paraZh.8: 补墙角理皮包摸布料，奶奶织帽我编椅面。
paraZh.9: 铺布晾衣上油挂坠，劣货假币一概不留。
paraZh.10: 假珠易碎修补耐用，朴素胜过一时奢华。
paraZh.11: 珠宝玉饰装点裙子，绣花染色迎春日舞会。
